name: Change Status (existing members only)
summary: Changes the program status of leads that are ALREADY members of the program. Leads not in the program are not added.
whenToUse: For nudging existing members forward in a program. If you also want to ADD leads to the program, use Programs → Set Program Member Status instead.

path.name: programId
path.label: Program ID
path.hint: Find it via Programs → Get Programs.

body.hint: status = the program's status name (e.g. Member, Influenced, Completed — depends on the program's channel). input = the lead IDs to change.

notes: Only existing program members may be changed with this call — new members are ignored.
The status name must exist on the program (check the program's channel settings in the Marketo UI).
Body shape follows Marketo's sample API clients; if Marketo rejects it, the upsert call 'Set Program Member Status' is the safer choice.
